summary.text: Angela Thomas is the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 160 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Cheryle Perkins for an open seat.
Thomas also ran for the seat in 2018 and 2020.

paragraphs.text: Angela Thomas was the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 160 in 2018, when she received 24.5 percent of the vote in a general election won by Ben Baker.
She ran again in 2020 and received 21.0 percent against incumbent Baker.
She advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary.
